messages.content: 進行兩個獨立樣本的假設檢定，樣本1的分數為[22,33,42,12,34]，樣本2的分數為[23,45,44,14,38]，顯著性水平為0.05。

function.name: hypothesis_testing_ttest_ind
function.description: Conducts a hypothesis test for two independent samples. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample1.description: First set of observations (array of numbers).

sample2.description: Second set of observations (array of numbers).

significance_level.description: Significance level of the test (default: 0.05) This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
We need to perform an independent t-test on two samples. We have sample1: [22,33,42,12,34], sample2: [23,45,44,14,38]. Significance level alpha=0.05.

We should call the function hypothesis_testing_ttest_ind with sample1 and sample2 and significance_level=0.05. Then we need to interpret the result. The function likely returns some object containing p-value, test statistic, degrees of freedom, etc. We need to produce a response in Chinese presumably. The user asked "進行兩個獨立樣本的假設檢定" meaning "conduct a hypothesis test for two independent samples". So we should provide the test statistic, degrees of freedom, p-value, and conclusion at alpha=0.05. Let's compute manually or approximate? Let's quickly compute means and variances:

Sample1: values: 22,33,42,12,34. Sum = 22+33+42+12+34 = 143. Mean = 143/5 = 28.6. Sample2: 23,45,44,14,38 sum = 23+45+44+14+38 = 164. Mean = 164/5 = 32.8.

Compute sample variances (unbiased). For sample1: deviations: 22-28.6=-6.6; 33-28.6=4.4; 42-28.6=13.4; 12-28.6=-16.6; 34-28.6=5.4. Squares: (-6.6)^2=43.56; 4.4^2=19.36; 13.4^2=179.56; (-16.6)^2=275.56; 5.4^2=29.16. Sum squares = 43.56+19.36+179.56+275.56+29.16 = 547.2. Unbiased variance s1^2 = sum/(n-1)=547.2/4=136.8. Standard deviation s1 = sqrt(136.8)=11.704.

Sample2: deviations: 23-32.8=-9.8; 45-32.8=12.2; 44-32.8=11.2; 14-32.8=-18.8; 38-32.8=5.2. Squares: (-9.8)^2=96.04; 12.2^2=148.84; 11.2^2=125.44; (-18.8)^2=353.44; 5.2^2=27.04. Sum squares = 96.04+148.84+125.44+353.44+27.04 = 750.8. Unbiased variance s2^2 = 750.8/4=187.7. Standard deviation s2 = sqrt(187.7)=13.703.

Now compute pooled standard error: sqrt(s1^2/n1 + s2^2/n2) = sqrt(136.8/5 + 187.7/5) = sqrt(27.36 + 37.54) = sqrt(64.90) = 8.055. Difference in means = 28.6 - 32.8 = -4.2. Test statistic t = difference / SE = -4.2 / 8.055 = -0.521. Degrees of freedom using Welch's approximation: df = (s1^2/n1 + s2^2/n2)^2 / ((s1^2/n1)^2/(n1-1) + (s2^2/n2)^2/(n2-1)). Compute numerator: (27.36+37.54)^2 = 64.90^2 = 4210.81. Denominator: (27.36^2)/(4) + (37.54^2)/4 = (748.74)/4 + (1408.75)/4 = 187.185 + 352.188 = 539.373. df = 4210.81/539.373 = 7.806. Approximately 7.8 degrees of freedom.

Now p-value for two-sided test: t = -0.521, df ~7.8. Use t distribution. For df=8, t critical for alpha=0.05 two-tailed is about ±2.306. Our |t|=0.521 < 2.306, so fail to reject null. p-value > 0.05. Roughly p-value maybe around 0.61? Actually t=0.52, df=8, p-value two-sided ~0.62. So we conclude no significant difference.

But we might rely on the function to compute exact p-value. We'll call the function.
